Hi David,

Thanks again for the call this morning. I wanted to send across a single-sheet snapshot of our upcoming renewal and flag two items that could materially change our forecast: 1) an internal headcount freeze that may reduce usage through the quarter and 2) a contract review with our security team scheduled for mid-April.

Attached is the brightbyte_renewal_summary_Mar28.xlsx (single-sheet summary + ARR roll-forward). Appreciate it — cc'ing our finance mailbox in case they need to follow up.

Thanks Marta — received and useful context. Two quick things from our side:

1) Short note on commitments: I'll draft a one-page summary of our standard SLA + available add-ons (regional hosting, dedicated pools) and share by EOD next Tuesday (Apr 2). That will include the latency percentiles we've been seeing in your region and options for private deployment for the security review.

2) Pricing/commit flexibility: given the headcount freeze, would you prefer we model a baseline committed ARR with an optional expansion tranche you can activate? If so, we can draft language that keeps the committed price lower with a defined expansion window.

- David: produce SLA + hosting options memo (due 2028-04-02 EOD).

- Naomi: flag any procurement items that require legal redlines so we can route early.

Thanks — talk soon.
